intro: Timberling Sprouts is a quest given by the nature-watcher Denalan near Lake Al'Ameth in central Teldrassil. Concerned by the sudden and unnatural proliferation of woodland sprouts around the lake shores, Denalan asks travelers to uproot them before they mature into hostile timberlings. The task highlights early signs that a creeping corruption is disturbing the balance of the newly grown World Tree.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Small timberlings are sprouting around the waters of Lake Al'Ameth. I'm afraid these sprouts are beyond help -- we should try to clear them from the land before they grow large enough to cause trouble.
When you're wandering the lake, if you see any timberling sprouts please take them. Help keep our land clean!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. Have you found any sprouts near the waters?

clips.title: Completion
paras: That's a lot! I'm afraid they're spreading at a dangerous rate. I hope I can solve the riddle of what is tainting them.
Thank you for your help, friend. The land is a cleaner place from your efforts.
